title: Her 75 Challenge
body: This app is amazing! It's super easy to use and has several challenges you can choose from to help you become the best version of yourself! I'm currently doing the her 75 challenge which is just like 75 hard with just 1 slight difference. This app really helps you stay on track and you can add, remove and/or edit the rules to suit you best. I highly recommend!

title: In my rebuilding era
body: I have a hard time staying accountable and being disciplined. I just downloaded it today but I love everything about it so far - very easy to use, the aesthetics are amazing and beautiful, and the fact that I can make friends on here is super cool! Surrounding yourself with people who want the same things as you definitely helps along the way!

title: Getting My Life Back
body: I just started the 'Her 75 Days' challenge and I'm ready to put myself and my health first so I can be a better version of myself and be able to go out with friends in confidence and feel good. The app is super cute and really helps motivating me to stay on track!

title: ready to start!
body: I really love the layout, the simplicity and the functionality of this app. I'm super excited to start my own custom challenge, which is a lot more sustainable for me than following a challenge that has already been made. I'm glad that that option is there!

title: already excited to use this app
body: I just downloaded and instantly bought the plan. Not even bad considering I normally go to Dutch bros 5x or more a week. But I love the features offered and the app overall is just aesthetically pleasing and easy to use.

title: Something for everyone
body: The app gives several challenge options and it also allows you to customize your challenge if none of the other options are exactly what you're looking for.

title: So Aesthetic!
body: Just started today but already feeling super motivated! I've needed something like this to motivate me to take better care of myself and having something pretty to keep me organized and on track helps! It's also budget friendly.

title: 5 stars
body: I just started using Her 75 today, and so far I'm really enjoying the layout and motivation it provides. The app feels simple to navigate, and I like how it keeps everything organized in a way that makes starting a structured routine feel less overwhelming.

title: 5 stars 2
body: I've been using Her 75 for a little while now and I honestly love it. It's super simple, easy to use, and actually keeps me accountable every single day. The daily checklist helps me stay on track without feeling overwhelmed, and seeing my progress build up over time is really motivating.

title: Review
body: It took me very long to fill out all my info and i was super excited to use the app but then it told me that i have no choice but to pay. Even in the app store by the download button it didnt say 'in app purchases' so i assumed there was a free option. Im pretty sad about this because im a highschool student who doesnt have $15 to give to an app every month. This review was not meant for me to complain, but for maybe a hope for change for the app.
